name: gq-tax-overview
description: Overview of the Equatorial Guinea tax system for tax year 2026. Sets out the governing law, Ley 1/2024 General Tributaria, which replaced Ley 4/2004, the tax authority, currency, tax year, residence, main rates and deadlines, and where each topic lives in this pack. Use for questions such as what taxes apply in Equatorial Guinea, what is the corporate tax rate, what is the VAT rate, what is the top income tax rate, who collects tax in Equatorial Guinea, and when are returns due. Applies to companies, sole traders, employees and foreign investors. Each figure links to the skill and the law that owns it, and the detail stays in those sibling skills.
